taiwan_news.title: 健保10月新制：CAR-T擴大給付至淋巴瘤第二線 低劑量抗凝血劑條件放寬
taiwan_news.summary: 健保10/1起，單次約819萬元的CAR-T細胞治療擴及瀰漫性大B細胞淋巴瘤第二線，估5年36至88人受惠；低劑量rivaroxaban併用阿斯匹靈放寬為2年內發生1次事件即可用，約8千至1.6萬人受惠。

taiwan_news.title: 清大團隊開發AI健康減重系統 依年齡層給個人化建議、重點在不復胖
taiwan_news.summary: 清華大學周卓煇教授團隊開發AI減重專家系統，把飲食、運動、睡眠與夜間光照一併納入，依青年、中年、高齡分別給建議，強調維持健康與降低復胖風險，而非追求快速減重。

taiwan_news.topic: 公費流感新冠疫苗開打
taiwan_news.title: 「左流右新」10/1開打：公費流感、新冠疫苗同步接種 11/2擴及50歲以上
taiwan_news.summary: 公費流感與新冠疫苗10/1同步開打，第一階段含65歲以上長者、孕婦、學齡前幼兒及高風險慢性病人等；流感疫苗採購約705萬劑、新冠240萬劑，全國近4,000家合約院所可接種，11/2起擴及50歲以上成人。

taiwan_news.title: 肚子脹到快撐破、胃鏡大腸鏡卻正常？醫師：腹脹不等於氣太多，有4種成因
taiwan_news.summary: 肝膽腸胃科醫師吳文傑指出腹脹有4類原因：內容物增加（吞氣、發酵、便秘）、腸胃蠕動變慢、內臟過度敏感、腹肌與橫膈協調異常，不能只靠消脹氣藥；若合併體重下降、反覆嘔吐、血便或劇烈腹痛應盡快就醫。

taiwan_news.title: 胰臟癌7成早期無症狀 醫師點名4大警訊與5類高風險族群
taiwan_news.summary: 醫師林相宏指出，胰臟癌早期約7成沒有症狀，出現症狀才確診者8成已是第三期以上；黃疸、久不癒的上腹痛或背痛、灰白色脂肪便、體重明顯下降是4大警訊。60歲以上、飲酒、慢性胰臟炎、糖尿病及吸菸者（風險約3倍）要特別留意。

nejm.title: Survodutide Once Weekly in Adults with Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes.
nejm.title_zh: 每週一次 Survodutide 用於肥胖合併第 2 型糖尿病成人
nejm.abstract: SYNCHRONIZE-2, a double-blind phase 3 trial, randomized 752 adults with type 2 diabetes and BMI ≥27 to weekly survodutide 3.6 mg, 6.0 mg, or placebo. At week 76, mean weight change was −8.2%, −9.8%, and −3.9% (95% CI −4.9 to −2.9 for placebo); ≥5% weight loss occurred in 57.6%, 64.5%, and 35.1% (P<0.001). HbA1c fell 0.9, 0.8, and 0.2 percentage points. Gastrointestinal adverse events occurred in 72.8%, 77.7%, and 38.6%.
nejm.abstract_zh: SYNCHRONIZE-2 第三期雙盲試驗納入 752 位第 2 型糖尿病且 BMI ≥27 成人，隨機接受每週 survodutide 3.6 mg、6.0 mg 或安慰劑。第 76 週體重變化分別為 −8.2%、−9.8%、−3.9%，減重 ≥5% 比例 57.6%、64.5%、35.1%（P<0.001）；糖化血色素下降 0.9、0.8、0.2 個百分點；腸胃道不良事件 72.8%、77.7%、38.6%。

nejm.title: Retatrutide, a Triple Hormone Receptor Agonist, for Treatment of Obesity.
nejm.title_zh: 三重荷爾蒙受體促效劑 Retatrutide 治療肥胖症
nejm.abstract: TRIUMPH-1, a double-blind phase 3 trial, randomized 2339 adults with obesity without diabetes to weekly retatrutide 4, 9, or 12 mg or placebo for 80 weeks. Mean weight change was −17.6%, −23.7%, and −25.0% versus −3.9% with placebo (P<0.001 for 9 mg and 12 mg). In 574 participants with knee osteoarthritis, WOMAC pain fell 3.2, 3.5, and 3.6 versus 1.9 points; apnea-hypopnea events also decreased significantly in 243 with obstructive sleep apnea.
nejm.abstract_zh: TRIUMPH-1 第三期雙盲試驗將 2339 位無糖尿病之肥胖成人隨機分派至每週 retatrutide 4、9、12 mg 或安慰劑共 80 週。體重變化為 −17.6%、−23.7%、−25.0%，安慰劑 −3.9%（P<0.001）。574 位膝骨關節炎者 WOMAC 疼痛分數下降 3.2、3.5、3.6 對 1.9 分；243 位阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止者 AHI 亦顯著改善。

nejm.title: Giredestrant plus Everolimus in Advanced Breast Cancer.
nejm.title_zh: Giredestrant 併用 Everolimus 治療晚期乳癌
nejm.abstract: The open-label phase 3 evERA trial randomized 373 patients with ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer progressing after a CDK4/6 inhibitor to giredestrant–everolimus or standard endocrine therapy–everolimus. Among 207 patients in the mutated-tumor subgroup, median progression-free survival was 10.0 versus 5.5 months (HR 0.38; 95% CI 0.27–0.54); overall, 8.8 versus 5.5 months (HR 0.56; 95% CI 0.44–0.71; P<0.001). Stomatitis occurred in 47.3% and 48.9%.
nejm.abstract_zh: evERA 第三期開放性試驗納入 373 位曾用 CDK4/6 抑制劑後惡化之 ER 陽性、HER2 陰性晚期乳癌病人，比較 giredestrant 或標準內分泌治療併用 everolimus。207 位突變腫瘤者 PFS 中位數 10.0 對 5.5 個月（HR 0.38；95% CI 0.27–0.54）；整體 8.8 對 5.5 個月（HR 0.56；0.44–0.71）。

lancet.title: 8 weeks versus 12 weeks of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir for treatment-naive, non-cirrhotic, chronic hepatitis C (RESOLVE): a multicentre, open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial in India.
lancet.title_zh: Sofosbuvir-velpatasvir 8 週對比 12 週治療未曾接受治療、無肝硬化之慢性 C 型肝炎（RESOLVE）：印度多中心、開放性、不劣性隨機對照試驗
lancet.abstract: RESOLVE, an open-label non-inferiority trial at five public hospitals in India, randomized 880 treatment-naive, non-cirrhotic adults with HCV mono-infection to sofosbuvir–velpatasvir for 8 or 12 weeks. Per-protocol SVR12 was 98.8% (410/415) versus 99.0% (397/401), risk difference 0.2% (95% CI −1.5 to 1.9); intention-to-treat SVR12 was 93.5% versus 91.8%. Non-inferiority (5% margin) was met, with no drug-related serious adverse events or discontinuations.
lancet.abstract_zh: RESOLVE 為印度五家公立醫院之開放性不劣性試驗，880 位未曾治療、無肝硬化之 HCV 單一感染成人隨機接受 sofosbuvir–velpatasvir 8 或 12 週。依計畫書分析 SVR12 為 98.8% 對 99.0%（風險差 0.2%；95% CI −1.5 至 1.9），意向治療分析 93.5% 對 91.8%，達不劣性；無藥物相關嚴重不良事件。

lancet.title: Cardiovascular safety of orforglipron versus insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk (ACHIEVE-4): a phase 3, event-driven, randomised, open-label, non-inferiority, active comparator trial.
lancet.title_zh: Orforglipron 對比 insulin glargine 用於心血管風險升高之第 2 型糖尿病成人的心血管安全性（ACHIEVE-4）：第三期、事件驅動、隨機、開放性、不劣性、活性對照試驗
lancet.abstract: ACHIEVE-4, an open-label, event-driven phase 3 trial, randomized 2749 adults with type 2 diabetes, BMI ≥25, and established cardiovascular or chronic kidney disease to oral orforglipron or insulin glargine. Over a median 2 years, MACE-4 occurred in 4.2% versus 5.0% (HR 0.84; 95% CI 0.59–1.20; p<0.0001 for non-inferiority). Gastrointestinal events occurred in 62.1% versus 14.2%, clinically significant hypoglycaemia in 6.8% versus 19.2%, and death in 1.4% versus 3.2%.
lancet.abstract_zh: ACHIEVE-4 第三期開放性事件驅動試驗將 2749 位第 2 型糖尿病、BMI ≥25 且具心血管或慢性腎臟病成人隨機分派至口服 orforglipron 或 insulin glargine。追蹤中位數 2 年，MACE-4 發生率 4.2% 對 5.0%（HR 0.84；95% CI 0.59–1.20，達不劣性）；腸胃道事件 62.1% 對 14.2%，顯著低血糖 6.8% 對 19.2%。

jama.title: Histologic Features and Clinical Outcomes of Lean Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease.
jama.title_zh: 精瘦型代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的組織學特徵與臨床預後
jama.abstract: Multinational retrospective study of 18 326 adults with biopsy-confirmed MASLD from 41 countries; 6.7% were lean by BMI. Lean MASLD had less advanced fibrosis (29.3% vs 37.2%) and type 2 diabetes (38.2% vs 48.3%), yet lean status was not independently associated with all-cause mortality (aHR, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.69-1.16) or clinical events (aHR, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.76-1.17). Advanced fibrosis predicted mortality (aHR, 2.10; 95% CI, 1.71-2.57); liver stiffness measurement remained accurate in lean patients (AUC, 0.87).
jama.abstract_zh: 41國18,326名切片確診MASLD成人之回溯性研究，6.7%依BMI屬精瘦型。精瘦型晚期纖維化較少（29.3%比37.2%），但全因死亡（aHR 0.90，95% CI 0.69-1.16）與臨床事件風險相近；預後取決於纖維化（F3-F4死亡aHR 2.10），肝硬度測量AUC 0.87。

jama.title: Vaccines for Cancer: A Translational Science Review.
jama.title_zh: 癌症疫苗：轉譯科學回顧
jama.abstract: Translational review: more than 2000 immunogenic tumor antigens have been identified. Sipuleucel-T reduced all-cause mortality vs placebo in metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer (HR, 0.78; 95% CI, 0.61-0.98), and talimogene laherparepvec increased durable responses in advanced melanoma (16.3% vs 2.1%). Adding the personalized mRNA vaccine mRNA-4157 to pembrolizumab improved relapse-free survival in resected high-risk melanoma (76.6% vs 60%; HR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.31-1.02). Adverse effects are generally mild; prevention trials are ongoing.
jama.abstract_zh: 轉譯回顧：已鑑定逾2000種免疫原性腫瘤抗原。Sipuleucel-T降低轉移性去勢抗性攝護腺癌全因死亡（HR 0.78，95% CI 0.61-0.98）；個人化mRNA疫苗mRNA-4157併用pembrolizumab提升高風險黑色素瘤術後無復發存活（76.6%比60%，HR 0.56）。不良反應多輕微。

jama.title: Tenecteplase Before Thrombectomy at 4.5 to 24 Hours for Basilar Artery Occlusion: The ATTENTION LATE Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 基底動脈阻塞發病4.5至24小時於取栓前給予Tenecteplase：ATTENTION LATE隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Open-label, blinded end point RCT at 40 Chinese stroke centers randomized 330 patients with moderate to severe basilar artery occlusion (NIHSS ≥10) presenting 4.5 to 24 hours after onset to intravenous tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg plus endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) or EVT alone. Functional independence (mRS 0-2) at 90 days was 30% in both groups (adjusted rate ratio, 0.92; 95% CI, 0.67-1.25). Symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage occurred in 5% vs 4%; 90-day mortality was 40% vs 43%.
jama.abstract_zh: 中國40家中心開放標籤、終點盲性RCT，納入330名發病4.5至24小時之中重度基底動脈阻塞病人，比較靜脈tenecteplase（0.25 mg/kg）加取栓與單獨取栓。90天功能獨立（mRS 0-2）兩組皆30%（校正率比0.92，95% CI 0.67-1.25）；症狀性顱內出血5%比4%，死亡率40%比43%。

jama.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 重大非心臟手術採全靜脈麻醉相較於吸入性麻醉：隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Pragmatic open-label RCT in 49 UK NHS hospitals randomized 2508 patients aged ≥50 years having elective major noncardiac surgery to propofol total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) or volatile inhalational anesthesia. Days alive and at home at 30 days were similar (mean, 22.5 vs 22.4 days; incidence rate ratio, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.99-1.02; P = .68), as were mortality, delirium, and major complications (12.4% overall). TIVA lowered rates of thirst, hoarseness, and nausea and vomiting; 2 awareness cases occurred, both with TIVA.
jama.abstract_zh: 英國49家醫院實用性RCT，2508名50歲以上重大非心臟手術病人隨機接受propofol全靜脈或吸入性麻醉。30天存活且居家天數相近（22.5比22.4天；發生率比1.00，95% CI 0.99-1.02），死亡、譫妄及重大併發症無差異；全靜脈組噁心嘔吐較少，但有2例術中知曉。

gastro.title: Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial of Translumbosacral Neuromodulation Therapy for Fecal Incontinence.
gastro.title_zh: 經腰薦神經調控治療大便失禁之隨機假刺激對照試驗
gastro.abstract: In this multicenter, double-blind, sham-controlled trial, 109 patients with fecal incontinence (≥1 leakage/week) received weekly translumbosacral magnetic neuromodulation (2400 or 3600 stimulations) or sham for 6 weeks. Responders (≥50% fewer weekly episodes) were 65.8%, 81.1% and 32.4%, respectively (odds ratio vs sham 3.91 and 8.53). Severity index, nerve conduction latencies and anal squeeze pressures improved versus sham, with no treatment-related serious adverse events.
gastro.abstract_zh: 109位大便失禁患者隨機接受每週經腰薦磁刺激2400次、3600次或假刺激共6週，失禁次數減少≥50%者分別為65.8%、81.1%、32.4%，無治療相關嚴重不良事件。

gastro.title: Nonadvanced Adenoma Number and Size as Predictors of Metachronous Advanced Colorectal Neoplasm: Implications for Surveillance Guidelines.
gastro.title_zh: 非進行性腺瘤之數目與大小作為異時性進行性大腸直腸腫瘤的預測因子：對追蹤指引的意涵
gastro.abstract: Among 16,870 adults aged 50-75 years with ≥2 colonoscopies (median follow-up 5.3 years), 5-year cumulative incidence of advanced colorectal neoplasm was 1.3%, 4.0%, 5.3% and 10.1% for 0, 1-2, 3-4 and 5-10 nonadvanced adenomas (hazard ratios 1.64, 2.75 and 5.21 versus none). Having ≥1 small (6-9 mm) adenoma raised risk versus diminutive-only: 8.1% vs 3.0% for 3-4 adenomas. Both number and size should guide surveillance intervals.
gastro.abstract_zh: 16,870位接受≥2次大腸鏡者中，非進行性腺瘤0、1–2、3–4、5–10顆之5年進行性腫瘤發生率為1.3%、4.0%、5.3%、10.1%；含6–9 mm腺瘤者風險更高。

gastro.title: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation for Symptom Improvement in Patients With Irritable Bowel Syndrome: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
gastro.title_zh: 糞便微菌叢移植改善大腸激躁症症狀：隨機對照試驗之系統性回顧與統合分析
gastro.abstract: This updated meta-analysis pooled 13 randomized trials (693 patients) of fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) for irritable bowel syndrome. By intention-to-treat, the risk ratio of symptoms not improving at 12 weeks versus placebo was 0.72 (95% CI 0.50-1.03); per-protocol it was 0.67 (0.46-0.97). Adverse events did not differ (RR 0.98). Single-dose FMT (RR 0.62) and Rome IV-defined IBS (RR 0.38) showed benefit, but certainty of evidence was very low.
gastro.abstract_zh: 統合13項隨機試驗693位大腸激躁症患者，糞便微菌叢移植12週症狀未改善之風險比為0.72（0.50–1.03），依計畫書分析0.67（0.46–0.97），證據確定性極低。

gastro.title: β-Glucan and Inulin Estimated Intake Are Associated With Reduced Risk of Crohn's Disease, Improved Gut Barrier and Systemic Inflammation Markers, and Multi-Omic Signatures in a High-Risk Cohort.
gastro.title_zh: 高風險世代中β-葡聚醣與菊糖估計攝取量與克隆氏症風險降低、腸道屏障及全身發炎指標改善和多體學特徵之相關性
gastro.abstract: The Genetic, Environmental, Microbial Project followed 3314 asymptomatic first-degree relatives of Crohn's disease patients for a median 8.5 years; 94 developed Crohn's disease. Higher estimated β-glucan (HR 0.70; 95% CI 0.54-0.92) and inulin (HR 0.68; 0.49-0.96) intake were associated with lower risk, lower lactulose-mannitol ratio, fewer pathobionts and lower C-reactive protein and other inflammation-related proteins. Associations were modified by baseline microbiota, supporting microbiome-informed dietary prevention trials.
gastro.abstract_zh: 追蹤3314位克隆氏症患者一等親中位數8.5年，94人發病。β-葡聚醣（HR 0.70）與菊糖（HR 0.68）攝取較高者風險較低，腸道通透性與CRP等發炎指標亦較低。

hepato.title: Beyond second-line therapy: Strategic sequencing of systemic treatments in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.
hepato.title_zh: 超越第二線治療：晚期肝細胞癌全身性治療的策略性排序
hepato.abstract: This review integrates phase II/III trials and real-world studies including more than 4000 patients to outline sequencing of systemic therapy for advanced HCC beyond first-line immunotherapy. After immune-based combinations, tyrosine kinase inhibitors remain active, with median overall survival of about 10-11 months, while preserved liver function determines eligibility and postprogression survival. The authors discuss the BCLC "upon response" concept, the CUSE framework (complexity, uncertainty, subjectivity, emotion), conversion therapy and "drug-off" strategies.
hepato.abstract_zh: 綜論整合逾4000位患者之試驗與真實世界資料：晚期肝癌免疫組合治療後，酪胺酸激酶抑制劑仍有效，整體存活中位數約10–11個月，肝功能保存決定後續治療資格。

hepato.title: Clinical utilization of testing for cell-free DNA in hepatocellular cancer.
hepato.title_zh: 游離DNA檢測於肝細胞癌之臨床應用
hepato.abstract: Semiannual ultrasound with alpha-fetoprotein has suboptimal sensitivity and implementation for early HCC detection, and post-treatment monitoring is not tailored to tumor aggressiveness. This review summarizes cell-free DNA (cfDNA) applications in HCC: risk stratification, early detection, prognostication and minimal residual disease. Early detection is most advanced; cfDNA assays combined with clinical and serum parameters show sensitivity noninferior or superior to ultrasound, with phase 3 validation ongoing. Other uses remain in early clinical development.
hepato.abstract_zh: 綜論游離DNA於肝細胞癌之應用：早期偵測進展最快，結合臨床與血清指標後敏感度不劣於或優於超音波，第三期驗證進行中；風險分層、預後與微量殘存病灶仍屬早期發展。

hepato.title: Incorporating artificial intelligence into imaging for surveillance and diagnosis of liver cancer: Innovations, challenges, and clinical translation.
hepato.title_zh: 將人工智慧納入肝癌監測與診斷影像：創新、挑戰與臨床轉譯
hepato.abstract: Current liver cancer surveillance and diagnosis (ultrasound, contrast-enhanced CT/MRI) suffer from operator dependence, limited sensitivity and interpretive variability. This review describes how deep learning improves ultrasound detection of small tumors, achieves expert-level lesion detection, segmentation and characterization on CT and MRI supporting LI-RADS, and in digital pathology distinguishes HCC from cholangiocarcinoma and predicts future cancer. Barriers include data privacy, regulatory approval, cost and algorithmic bias; large prospective multicenter validation is needed.
hepato.abstract_zh: 綜論人工智慧於肝癌影像：深度學習提升超音波對小腫瘤之偵測，CT／MRI病灶判讀達專家水準並支援LI-RADS；隱私、法規、成本與偏差仍為障礙，需前瞻多中心驗證。

hepato.title: Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) in clinical trials: Views and practical updates from DILI specialists at FDA.
hepato.title_zh: 臨床試驗中的藥物性肝損傷（DILI）：美國FDA DILI專家的觀點與實務更新
hepato.abstract: FDA DILI specialists note that drug-induced liver injury remains a major challenge in drug development: just 1 or 2 severe hepatotoxicity cases in a trial can raise approval concerns, and severe cases still occur in late-phase trials and post-market. Current risk-assessment paradigms are challenged by biologic agents with distinct hepatotoxicity, smaller underpowered rare-disease trials, and drugs for acute and chronic liver diseases. They highlight eight key topics needing clarification, research and discussion.
hepato.abstract_zh: 美國FDA專家指出，試驗中僅1或2例嚴重肝毒性即可影響藥物核准；生物製劑、小型罕病試驗與肝病用藥挑戰現行藥物性肝損傷風險評估，並提出八項待釐清之關鍵議題。

diabetes.title: Effect of semaglutide on kidney outcomes in the SELECT, FLOW, and SOUL trials: a prespecified pooled analysis.
diabetes.title_zh: Semaglutide 對腎臟結果的影響：SELECT、FLOW 與 SOUL 試驗之預設統合分析
diabetes.abstract: This prespecified participant-level pooled analysis of SELECT, FLOW, and SOUL (N=30,787; mean follow-up 39.5-47.5 months) compared semaglutide with placebo. The primary kidney composite (persistent ≥50% eGFR reduction, kidney failure, kidney-related or cardiovascular death) occurred in 973 vs 1134 participants (HR 0.84, 95% CI 0.77-0.91). A narrower composite excluding cardiovascular death was also reduced (347 vs 416; HR 0.80, 0.69-0.92). Safety was similar between groups.
diabetes.abstract_zh: SELECT、FLOW、SOUL 三項試驗個別受試者資料統合分析（N=30,787）：semaglutide 相較安慰劑降低主要腎臟複合終點（973 vs 1134 例；HR 0.84，95% CI 0.77–0.91），排除心血管死亡後 HR 0.80（0.69–0.92），安全性相近。

diabetes.title: Once-weekly IcoSema versus once-daily insulin glargine U100 in type 2 diabetes management (COMBINE 4): an open-label, multicentre, treat-to-target, randomised, phase 3b trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 每週一次 IcoSema 對比每日一次 insulin glargine U100 治療第 2 型糖尿病（COMBINE 4）：開放性、多中心、達標治療、隨機分派第 3b 期試驗
diabetes.abstract: COMBINE 4, a 40-week open-label phase 3b trial, randomised 485 insulin-naive adults with type 2 diabetes (HbA1c ≥8.0%) on oral agents to once-weekly IcoSema (icodec plus semaglutide) or daily glargine U100. HbA1c fell 3.32 vs 2.44 percentage points (ETD -0.88, 95% CI -1.12 to -0.63; p<0.001). Bodyweight changed -0.79 vs +3.81 kg (ETD -4.61 kg). Clinically significant or severe hypoglycaemia was lower (0.29 vs 0.59 episodes per person-year; rate ratio 0.56).
diabetes.abstract_zh: COMBINE 4 納入 485 位口服藥控制不佳之第 2 型糖尿病人，40 週時每週一次 IcoSema 較 glargine U100 多降 HbA1c 0.88 個百分點（−3.32 vs −2.44），體重差 −4.61 kg，臨床顯著或嚴重低血糖發生率較低（率比 0.56）。

diabetes.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly semaglutide 2·4 mg in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity (STEP 12): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3b trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 每週一次 semaglutide 2.4 mg 用於華人過重或肥胖成人之療效與安全性（STEP 12）：隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心第 3b 期試驗
diabetes.abstract: STEP 12 randomised 242 adults in mainland China and Taiwan with BMI 24 to <28 kg/m2 plus at least one weight-related comorbidity, or BMI 28 to <30 kg/m2, 2:1 to weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo plus lifestyle intervention for 44 weeks. Bodyweight changed -12.1% vs -2.2% (difference -9.9 percentage points, 95% CI -11.8 to -8.0; p<0.0001); 80.5% vs 24.4% achieved at least 5% weight loss (OR 14.8). Adverse events occurred in 87.6% vs 75.3%, mostly gastrointestinal.
diabetes.abstract_zh: STEP 12 於中國大陸與台灣納入 242 位依在地 BMI 標準定義之過重或肥胖成人，44 週時 semaglutide 2.4 mg 組體重降 12.1%、安慰劑組 2.2%（差 −9.9 個百分點）；達減重至少 5% 者 80.5% vs 24.4%，不良事件以腸胃道為主。

ckd.title: ASN Kidney Health Guidance on the Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome.
ckd.title_zh: 美國腎臟醫學會（ASN）心血管－腎臟－代謝（CKM）症候群腎臟健康指引
ckd.abstract: This ASN Kidney Health Guidance gives nephrology clinicians practical advice on screening, risk stratification, and pharmacologic management across the cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) spectrum. It emphasises longitudinal eGFR and albuminuria assessment, cardiac biomarkers and imaging, and integrating the PREVENT equations with the Kidney Failure Risk Equation. It reviews sequential and combination use of SGLT2 inhibitors, GLP-1-based therapies, and nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists alongside renin-angiotensin system inhibitors and lipid-lowering therapy, noting evidence gaps in dialysis, transplant, and glomerular disease.
ckd.abstract_zh: ASN 指引為腎臟科提供 CKM 症候群之篩檢、風險分層與藥物治療建議：強調長期追蹤 eGFR 與白蛋白尿，整合 PREVENT 與 KFRE 風險模型，並探討 SGLT2 抑制劑、GLP-1 類藥物、非類固醇 MRA 的序貫與合併使用，以及透析、移植族群的證據缺口。

ckd.title: New insights from DAPA-CKD indicate that dapagliflozin modulates key pathways related to kidney outcomes.
ckd.title_zh: DAPA-CKD 新見解：dapagliflozin 調控與腎臟結果相關之關鍵路徑
ckd.abstract: This plasma proteomic analysis measured 3072 circulating proteins in 2485 of 4304 DAPA-CKD participants (57.7%). Pathways most strongly associated with the composite kidney outcome involved fibrosis and inflammation. After 12 months, dapagliflozin modified 216 proteins versus placebo; kidney injury molecule-1 fell most (-14.9%, 95% CI -17.9 to -11.7). Of 137 outcome-associated pathways, 35 (25%) were modified by dapagliflozin, relating to extracellular matrix remodeling, inflammation and fibrosis, and immune-vascular interactions.
ckd.abstract_zh: DAPA-CKD 血漿蛋白質體分析（2485 人、3072 種蛋白）：dapagliflozin 治療 12 個月改變 216 種蛋白，KIM-1 降幅最大（−14.9%）；137 條與腎臟終點相關路徑中 35 條（25%）受其調控，涉及發炎、纖維化與細胞外基質重塑。

ckd.title: Time in Target Range for Hemoglobin A1c and Systolic Blood Pressure: Association With Adverse Kidney Events.
ckd.title_zh: 糖化血色素與收縮壓之目標範圍內時間：與不良腎臟事件的關聯
ckd.abstract: This post hoc cohort analysis of 6,542 ACCORD participants with type 2 diabetes and hypertension assessed time in target range (TTR) for HbA1c and systolic blood pressure over the first 12 months. Versus the lowest tertile, 100% HbA1c-TTR was associated with lower risk of the composite kidney outcome (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.68-0.94), as was 100% SBP-TTR (HR 0.68, 0.58-0.80). Both TTRs above 80% versus both at or below 80% gave HR 0.71 (0.61-0.83).
ckd.abstract_zh: ACCORD 試驗 6,542 人事後分析：前 12 個月 HbA1c 目標範圍內時間達 100% 者，複合腎臟終點風險較最低三分位低 20%（HR 0.80）；收縮壓達 100% 者低 32%（HR 0.68）；兩者皆 >80% 相較皆 ≤80% 者 HR 0.71（0.61–0.83）。

taiwan_news.title: 116年度健保總額協商達共識 首度突破1兆元、成長率5.5%
taiwan_news.summary: 衛福部宣布116年度健保總額協商達成共識，總額1兆434億元，成長率5.5%。其中「糖心腎症候群」慢性病整合照護編列166.95億元、家醫大平台與居家急症照護862億元、罕病與血友病234.8億元，另挹注57.96億元改善護理人力。

taiwan_news.title: 世界心臟日：國人三高盛行率高、逾3成不自知 國健署推「護心4法」
taiwan_news.summary: 國健署引用2020–2024國民營養健康調查：20歲以上成人高血壓30.4%、高血糖13.1%、高血脂31%，其中3至6成不知道自己有三高；2025年心臟病奪走2.2萬人。署長沈靜芬呼籲善用成人預防保健、722居家量血壓、科學算病館評估10年心血管風險。

taiwan_news.title: 中秋烤肉團圓 疾管署：近4週70起腹瀉群聚、近9成驗出諾羅病毒
taiwan_news.summary: 疾管署監測第37週全國腹瀉急診就診12.6萬人次，第34–37週共70起腹瀉群聚、28起檢出病原，其中25起（89.3%）為諾羅病毒，另有金黃色葡萄球菌與沙門氏菌。提醒中秋烤肉生熟食分開、食材徹底煮熟、肥皂勤洗手，有症狀者勿處理食物並在家休息。
taiwan_news.source: 衛生福利部疾病管制署

taiwan_news.title: 大便出現「黑色柏油便」或「灰白色」別拖 醫：可能是潰瘍出血或膽道阻塞
taiwan_news.summary: 腸胃科醫師楊子緯提醒，正常糞便因膽色素呈黃褐色；若出現黑色柏油便，代表上消化道出血，常見於胃潰瘍、十二指腸潰瘍甚至胃癌；灰白或陶土色便則是膽汁受阻，須警覺膽管結石或胰臟頭部腫瘤壓迫。兩種顏色持續1–2天以上就應盡快就醫做肝膽與影像檢查。

taiwan_news.title: 「咖啡＋綠茶」能減脂？營養師：研究僅11人、肝功能異常等6類人別亂喝
taiwan_news.summary: 近期流行「咖啡加綠茶」燃脂，營養師蔡宗真指出，原始研究刊於《Nutrients》，僅11名健康男性、為期3週，觀察到餐後血糖與GLP-1變化，但體組成幾乎沒變，不等於減重。孕婦、易心悸、失眠、焦慮、腸胃敏感及肝病或肝功能異常者應避免；每日咖啡因勿超過300毫克，兒茶素EGCG超過800毫克恐傷肝。

nejm.title: Effect of Screening with Multicancer Early-Detection Test on Late-Stage Cancer Diagnosis
nejm.title_zh: 多癌症早期偵測血液檢測篩檢對晚期癌症診斷之影響（NHS-Galleri 試驗）
nejm.abstract: In the NHS-Galleri randomized trial in England, 142,250 adults aged 50-77 were assigned to annual blood-based multicancer early-detection testing plus usual care or usual care alone for three rounds. The incidence of stage III-IV cancer across 12 prespecified cancers did not differ (incidence rate ratio 1.03; 95% CI 0.92-1.14; P=0.63). Stage IV cancer rate ratio was 0.86 (95% CI 0.74-1.00). Fewer than 1% had trial-related adverse events.
nejm.abstract_zh: 英國 NHS-Galleri 隨機試驗納入 142,250 名 50–77 歲成人，比較三輪年度多癌症早期偵測血液檢測加常規照護與常規照護。12 種預設癌症之 III–IV 期發生率無顯著差異（發生率比 1.03，95% CI 0.92–1.14，P=0.63）；IV 期發生率比 0.86（0.74–1.00）。試驗相關不良事件低於 1%。

nejm.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with Intermediate Stroke Risk
nejm.title_zh: 中度中風風險心房顫動患者之抗凝治療（SINGLE-AF 試驗）
nejm.abstract: SINGLE-AF, a multicenter open-label trial in South Korea, randomized 1803 patients with atrial fibrillation and intermediate stroke risk (CHA2DS2-VASc 1 in men, 2 in women) to DOAC therapy or no anticoagulation. At 24 months the composite of stroke, systemic embolism, major bleeding, or cardiovascular death occurred in 0.5% versus 1.5% (HR 0.31; 95% CI 0.10-0.94; P=0.03). Stroke occurred in 0.3% versus 1.1%; major bleeding was similar.
nejm.abstract_zh: 南韓多中心開放性 SINGLE-AF 試驗將 1803 名中度中風風險（男 CHA2DS2-VASc 1 分、女 2 分）心房顫動患者隨機分派接受 DOAC 或不抗凝。24 個月時中風、全身性栓塞、重大出血或心血管死亡複合終點為 0.5% 對 1.5%（HR 0.31，95% CI 0.10–0.94，P=0.03）；中風 0.3% 對 1.1%，重大出血相近。

nejm.title: Oveporexton for Narcolepsy Type 1 - Results from Two Phase 3 Trials
nejm.title_zh: Oveporexton 治療第一型猝睡症：兩項第三期試驗結果
nejm.abstract: Two phase 3 randomized placebo-controlled trials (First Light, n=168; Radiant Light, n=105) evaluated oveporexton, an oral orexin receptor 2 agonist, over 12 weeks in narcolepsy type 1. Mean sleep latency on the Maintenance of Wakefulness Test improved 14.3-19.8 minutes versus -0.4 to -0.8 with placebo; Epworth scores fell 9.7-11.8 points versus 1.5-1.7; weekly cataplexy decreased 79-89% versus 28-39% (all P<0.001). Urinary frequency and transient insomnia were common.
nejm.abstract_zh: 兩項第三期隨機安慰劑對照試驗（First Light 168 人、Radiant Light 105 人）評估口服 orexin 2 受體促效劑 oveporexton 治療第一型猝睡症 12 週。清醒維持測試睡眠潛時改善 14.3–19.8 分鐘（安慰劑 -0.4 至 -0.8）；Epworth 嗜睡量表下降 9.7–11.8 分（安慰劑 1.5–1.7）；每週猝倒減少 79–89%（安慰劑 28–39%），皆 P<0.001。常見頻尿與暫時性失眠。

lancet.title: Faecal microbiota transplantation in irritable bowel syndrome (REFIT2): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
lancet.title_zh: 糞便微菌叢移植治療大腸激躁症（REFIT2）：隨機雙盲安慰劑對照第三期試驗
lancet.abstract: REFIT2, a phase 3 double-blind trial at five Norwegian hospitals, randomized 450 adults with moderate-to-severe IBS (IBS-SSS >=175) 2:1 to a single rectal enema of donor faeces or autologous placebo. At 90 days, 40% of the donor group and 38% of the placebo group achieved a >=75-point IBS-SSS reduction (difference 1.9 percentage points; 95% CI -8.1 to 12.0; P=0.76). Adverse events were similar, showing no clinical benefit of FMT in IBS.
lancet.abstract_zh: 挪威五家醫院之第三期雙盲 REFIT2 試驗，將 450 名中重度大腸激躁症患者（IBS-SSS ≥175）以 2:1 隨機分派接受單次捐贈者糞便或自體安慰劑直腸灌注。90 天時 IBS-SSS 下降 ≥75 分者分別為 40% 與 38%（差異 1.9 個百分點，95% CI -8.1 至 12.0，P=0.76），不良事件相近，未顯示糞菌移植對 IBS 有臨床效益。

lancet.title: Switch to injectable cabotegravir-rilpivirine given every 8 weeks in adolescents living with HIV with virological suppression in sub-Saharan Africa (LATA): a randomised, open-label, multicentre, 96-week non-inferiority trial
lancet.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲病毒抑制之 HIV 青少年轉換為每 8 週長效注射 cabotegravir–rilpivirine（LATA）：隨機開放性多中心 96 週非劣性試驗
lancet.abstract: LATA randomized 476 virologically suppressed adolescents (12 to <20 years) with HIV in Kenya, South Africa, Uganda and Zimbabwe to long-acting injectable cabotegravir-rilpivirine every 8 weeks or daily oral dolutegravir-lamivudine-tenofovir. By week 96, confirmed viral load >=50 copies/mL occurred in 0.9% of the injectable group versus 6.4% of controls (difference -5.5%; 99% CI -10.3 to -1.5), meeting non-inferiority and demonstrating superiority (P=0.0013). Serious adverse events were similar.
lancet.abstract_zh: LATA 試驗在肯亞、南非、烏干達及辛巴威將 476 名病毒抑制之 HIV 青少年（12 至未滿 20 歲）隨機分派接受每 8 週長效注射 cabotegravir–rilpivirine 或每日口服 dolutegravir–lamivudine–tenofovir。至 96 週，確認病毒量 ≥50 copies/mL 者分別為 0.9% 與 6.4%（差異 -5.5%，99% CI -10.3 至 -1.5），達非劣性並證明優越性（P=0.0013）；嚴重不良事件相近。

jama.title: Addition of High-Dose Vitamin D3 to Standard Treatment in Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: The SOLARIS Randomized Clinical Trial (Alliance A021703)
jama.title_zh: 轉移性大腸直腸癌標準治療加上高劑量維生素D3：SOLARIS 隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Double-blind phase 3 trial of 455 previously untreated metastatic colorectal cancer patients receiving mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI plus bevacizumab, randomized to high-dose vitamin D3 (8000 IU loading then 4000 IU daily) or standard 400 IU daily. Median progression-free survival was 11.8 vs 10.3 months (1-sided P = .25); objective response 51% vs 44% (P = .12); median overall survival 25.6 vs 27.0 months. High-dose vitamin D3 did not improve PFS, contradicting earlier phase 2 findings.
jama.abstract_zh: 第三期雙盲試驗納入455位未曾治療的轉移性大腸直腸癌患者，在化療加bevacizumab基礎上隨機給予高劑量（負荷8000 IU後每日4000 IU）或標準400 IU維生素D3。中位無惡化存活11.8對10.3個月（P=.25），客觀反應率51%對44%，總存活25.6對27.0個月，高劑量維生素D3未改善預後。

jama.title: Dapagliflozin and Acute Kidney Injury Following Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial
jama.title_zh: Dapagliflozin 與心臟手術後急性腎損傷：隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Multicenter double-blind placebo-controlled trial in the Netherlands randomized 784 adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery to dapagliflozin 10 mg or placebo daily from the day before surgery through postoperative day 2 (4 doses). Acute kidney injury by KDIGO criteria within 7 days occurred in 28% vs 52% (relative risk 0.54; 95% CI 0.45-0.65; P < .001). Atrial fibrillation (45% both groups) and reoperation (11% vs 10%) were similar. Brief perioperative SGLT2 inhibition reduced postoperative AKI.
jama.abstract_zh: 荷蘭多中心雙盲試驗將784位接受擇期心臟手術的成人隨機分至術前一天起每日dapagliflozin 10 mg或安慰劑共4劑。術後7天內KDIGO定義急性腎損傷發生率28%對52%（相對風險0.54，95% CI 0.45-0.65，P<.001），心房顫動（各45%）與再手術率相似，短期周術期SGLT2抑制劑可降低急性腎損傷。

jama.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer: A Randomized Clinical Trial
jama.title_zh: 立體定位放射治療對比中度低分次IMRT用於局限性中風險攝護腺癌：隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: NRG-GU005 phase 3 trial at 136 centers randomized 698 men with intermediate-risk localized prostate cancer to SBRT (36.25 Gy in 5 fractions) or moderately hypofractionated IMRT (70 Gy/28 or 60 Gy/20 fractions). At 2 years, urinary irritative decline was similar (35.4% vs 33.7%), but SBRT had fewer bowel-domain declines (34.9% vs 43.8%; P = .03) and fewer grade 3-4 genitourinary events (0.6% vs 2.5%). Three-year disease-free survival was 88.6% for SBRT vs 92.1% for IMRT; SBRT was not superior.
jama.abstract_zh: NRG-GU005第三期試驗於136個中心將698位中風險局限性攝護腺癌患者隨機分至SBRT（36.25 Gy分5次）或中度低分次IMRT。2年時泌尿刺激症狀惡化比例相似（35.4%對33.7%），但SBRT腸道生活品質惡化較少（34.9%對43.8%，P=.03）、3-4級泌尿不良事件較少（0.6%對2.5%）；3年無病存活88.6%對92.1%，SBRT未顯優越。

jama.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Effectiveness and Safety for the 2026-2027 Respiratory Season
jama.title_zh: 2026-2027呼吸道疾病季節COVID-19疫苗效力與安全性系統性回顧
jama.abstract: Systematic review of studies published August 2025 to June 2026 on US-licensed COVID-19 vaccines identified 155 eligible publications (15 RCTs, 84 comparative observational studies). Updated vaccines were associated with reduced hospitalization in adults 65 or older (vaccine effectiveness 53%; 95% CI 37%-65%) and adults 18-64 (54%). Maternal vaccination reduced infant COVID-19 hospital contacts (VE 50%-54%); pediatric ED visits fell 76%. Safety profiles were consistent with prior reviews, with no new signals including myocarditis.
jama.abstract_zh: 系統性回顧2025年8月至2026年6月發表的155篇研究（含15項隨機試驗、84項有對照觀察性研究）。更新版COVID-19疫苗使65歲以上成人住院風險降低53%（95% CI 37%-65%），18-64歲成人降低54%；孕期接種使嬰兒出生後2個月內COVID相關住院減少50%-54%，兒童急診就診減少76%。未發現新的安全性疑慮，包括心肌炎。

gastro.title: Impact of Family History on Colorectal Cancer Risk in Inflammatory Bowel Disease and in Matched General Population Comparators
gastro.title_zh: 家族史對發炎性腸道疾病患者及配對一般族群大腸癌風險的影響
gastro.abstract: Swedish nationwide register cohort (1996-2023) of 124,387 IBD patients and 1,213,641 matched comparators, median 11 years follow-up. Colorectal cancer incidence was 1.17 vs 0.88 per 1000 person-years (1882 vs 14,177 events). In IBD, having two or more affected first-degree relatives added 2.69 cases per 1000 person-years, whereas early-onset CRC heredity added only 0.42. Absolute effects of family history were similar in IBD and comparators, suggesting surveillance should prioritize multiple affected relatives.
gastro.abstract_zh: 瑞典全國登錄世代（1996-2023）納入124,387名IBD患者與1,213,641名配對對照，中位追蹤11年。大腸癌發生率分別為每1000人年1.17與0.88（1882對14,177例）。IBD患者若有兩位以上一級親屬罹癌，每1000人年多出2.69例；早發性大腸癌家族史僅多0.42例。家族史的絕對效應在IBD與對照相似，提示監測策略應優先針對多位親屬罹癌者，而非僅早發家族史。

gastro.title: Individualized Targeted Exclusion Diet Based on Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy Does Not Improve Irritable Bowel Syndrome Symptoms: A Randomized Controlled Crossover Trial
gastro.title_zh: 依共軛焦雷射內視鏡顯微術制定的個人化排除飲食無法改善大腸激躁症症狀：隨機對照交叉試驗
gastro.abstract: Double-blind randomized crossover trial (NCT05097872) testing whether confocal laser endomicroscopy can identify culprit foods in irritable bowel syndrome. Patients excluded up to two CLE-reactive foods (real diet) or two non-reactive foods (sham diet) for 4 weeks each. Response rates did not differ (42% vs 36%; odds ratio 1.33; P=.6), and symptom scores fell similarly (-30 vs -20; P=.7). Mucosal alterations appeared in 100% of 15 healthy volunteers, indicating nonspecific reactions.
gastro.abstract_zh: 此雙盲隨機交叉試驗（NCT05097872）檢驗共軛焦雷射內視鏡顯微術（CLE）能否找出大腸激躁症的致病食物。患者分別排除兩種CLE有反應（真飲食）與兩種無反應食物（假飲食）各4週。反應率無差異（42%對36%；勝算比1.33；P=.6），症狀分數改善相近（-30對-20；P=.7）。15名健康志願者黏膜變化達100%，顯示屬非特異性反應，不支持CLE臨床應用。

gastro.title: Dietary modulation of intestinal microbes prolongs survival in a Hirschsprung disease mouse model
gastro.title_zh: 飲食調節腸道菌相可延長赫氏腸症小鼠模型的存活期
gastro.abstract: In the piebald lethal (sl/sl) Hirschsprung disease mouse model, diet dramatically altered survival. A detrimental diet raised colonic epithelial oxygen, damaged mitochondria and expanded Enterobacteriaceae. A protective diet promoted epithelial hypoxia, raised antimicrobial peptides and fecal butyrate, improved barrier function, reduced Enterobacteriaceae and tripled median lifespan. Tungstate inhibition of Enterobacteriaceae anaerobic respiration also improved survival, suggesting dietary strategies might prevent Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis.
gastro.abstract_zh: 在赫氏腸症小鼠模型（piebald lethal, sl/sl）中，飲食顯著影響存活。不良飲食升高大腸上皮氧濃度、損傷粒線體並使腸內菌科增生；保護性飲食促進上皮缺氧、提升抗菌胜肽與糞便丁酸、改善屏障功能、減少腸內菌科，並使中位壽命延長為三倍。以鎢酸鹽抑制腸內菌科厭氧呼吸亦改善存活，提示飲食策略或可預防赫氏腸症相關腸炎。

gastro.title: Bioengineering a Probiotic to Bloom During Colonic Inflammation Promotes Reliable Efficacy in Translational Models of Colitis
gastro.title_zh: 生物工程改造益生菌使其於大腸發炎時增生，在結腸炎轉譯模型中展現穩定療效
gastro.abstract: Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 was engineered with the ttr operon (EcN::ttr) so it can use tetrathionate, an inflammation byproduct, as fuel. In acute dextran sodium sulfate and chronic mucin 2-deficient colitis models, EcN::ttr outperformed parent EcN and 5-aminosalicylate, blooming during inflammation and driving interleukin 10-dependent immunoregulation with less leukocyte infiltration, higher butyrate, reduced bacterial translocation and better zonula occludens-1 organization in human colonoids.
gastro.abstract_zh: 研究者將ttr操縱子導入大腸桿菌Nissle 1917（EcN::ttr），使其能利用發炎產物四硫磺酸鹽為能源。在急性DSS與慢性mucin 2缺陷結腸炎模型中，EcN::ttr療效優於原始EcN與5-胺基柳酸，能於發炎期增生，透過依賴介白素10的免疫調節減少白血球浸潤、提高丁酸、降低細菌移生，並改善人類腸道類器官的zonula occludens-1排列，為IBD菌相療法概念驗證。

hepato.title: Clinical utility of a 30% reduction in VCTE-derived liver stiffness measurement for identifying histologic improvement in MASH
hepato.title_zh: VCTE 肝硬度值下降 30% 用於判定 MASH 組織學改善的臨床效用
hepato.abstract: Prospective analysis of 160 adults with biopsy-proven MASH and F2-3 fibrosis from a phase 2b pegozafermin trial, with paired VCTE and biopsy. A >=30% relative decline in liver stiffness had an AUC of 0.68 (95% CI 0.58-0.77) for fibrosis regression without MASH worsening (adjusted OR 4.23), and AUC 0.62 in a 48-patient validation cohort. Accuracy was modest; better treatment-response biomarkers are needed.
hepato.abstract_zh: 納入 pegozafermin 第 2b 期試驗中 160 位切片證實 MASH 且 F2-3 纖維化的成人，同步比對 VCTE 與切片。肝硬度值相對下降 ≥30% 預測纖維化消退且 MASH 未惡化的 AUC 為 0.68（校正 OR 4.23），48 人驗證組 AUC 為 0.62。準確度僅屬中等，仍需更佳的治療反應生物標記。

hepato.title: AASLD AST NASPGHAN Practice Guideline on pediatric liver transplantation: Candidate evaluation
hepato.title_zh: AASLD/AST/NASPGHAN 兒童肝臟移植實務指引：候選者評估
hepato.abstract: This 2026 AASLD guideline, developed with AST and NASPGHAN, updates the 2014 recommendations on evaluating infants, children, and adolescents for liver transplantation. Based on a systematic literature review with Oxford CEBM grading and consensus voting, it defines indications, contraindications, and barriers to transplantation, and outlines best practices for pre-transplant assessment, organ allocation, and strategies to optimize survival while allowing individualized decisions.
hepato.abstract_zh: AASLD 聯合 AST 與 NASPGHAN 發布 2026 年兒童肝臟移植候選者評估指引，更新 2014 年版本。經系統性文獻回顧、Oxford CEBM 證據分級與共識投票，明訂嬰兒、兒童及青少年的移植適應症、禁忌症與障礙，並提供移植前評估、器官分配及提升存活率的最佳實務建議，同時保留個別化臨床彈性。

hepato.title: Beyond cirrhosis: Major adverse liver outcomes across homozygous and heterozygous alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency-associated liver disease
hepato.title_zh: 超越肝硬化：同合子與異合子 Alpha-1 抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症相關肝病的主要不良肝臟事件
hepato.abstract: Retrospective US Veterans cohort (2000-2025) of 22,537 genotyped participants (19,665 Pi*MM, 1,656 Pi*MZ, 281 Pi*SZ, 935 Pi*ZZ) with 352,612 person-years. Major adverse liver outcome risk rose with Z-allele burden: Pi*MZ aHR 1.25, Pi*SZ 1.51, Pi*ZZ 1.80 versus Pi*MM; 5-year MALO probability 3.5%, 5.5%, 5.3%, and 8.1%. Pi*ZZ raised risk of decompensation, HCC, transplant, and liver death; heterozygotes did not show excess HCC.
hepato.abstract_zh: 美國退伍軍人回溯性世代（2000–2025）納入 22,537 位有基因型檢測者，追蹤 352,612 人年。主要不良肝臟事件風險隨 Z 等位基因負荷遞增：相較 Pi*MM，Pi*MZ aHR 1.25、Pi*SZ 1.51、Pi*ZZ 1.80；5 年發生率分別為 3.5%、5.5%、5.3%、8.1%。Pi*ZZ 顯著增加失代償、肝癌、移植與肝臟相關死亡風險，異合子者則未見肝癌風險增加。

hepato.title: Safety and efficacy of zetomipzomib in relapsed or insufficiently responding autoimmune hepatitis: Results from the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2a PORTOLA study and open-label extension
hepato.title_zh: Zetomipzomib 治療復發或反應不足之自體免疫性肝炎的安全性與療效：隨機雙盲安慰劑對照第 2a 期 PORTOLA 試驗及開放延伸研究
hepato.abstract: PORTOLA, a phase 2a trial at 24 US centers, randomized 24 adults with AIH inadequately controlled on standard therapy to weekly subcutaneous zetomipzomib 60 mg or placebo for 24 weeks. Complete biochemical remission occurred in 50% versus 42.9%; remission with steroid taper to <=5 mg/day was 37.5% versus 14.3%. Injection-site reactions were frequent (93.8%), and 18.8% discontinued for adverse events. Larger trials are warranted.
hepato.abstract_zh: PORTOLA 為美國 24 中心第 2a 期試驗，將 24 位標準治療反應不足或復發的自體免疫性肝炎成人隨機分配至每週皮下注射 zetomipzomib 60 mg 或安慰劑 24 週。完全生化緩解率為 50% 對 42.9%；類固醇減量至 ≤5 mg/日並緩解者為 37.5% 對 14.3%。注射部位反應常見（93.8%），18.8% 因不良事件停藥，值得進行更大型試驗。

diabetes.title: Predictors of Peak Body Weight Loss With Semaglutide in the SELECT Trial
diabetes.title_zh: SELECT試驗中semaglutide最大體重減輕幅度的預測因子
diabetes.abstract: Prespecified SELECT analysis of 7,594 adults with obesity and atherosclerotic disease without diabetes treated with semaglutide for at least 1 year. Median peak weight loss was 12.5% (IQR 7.9-17.9) after a median 19 months. A model of baseline clinical characteristics explained under 10% of variability, mostly female sex. Women on 2.4 mg lost most (16.6% vs 12.4% in men); peak loss cannot be predicted from baseline features.
diabetes.abstract_zh: SELECT試驗預設分析納入7,594名無糖尿病、合併肥胖與動脈硬化疾病且持續使用semaglutide≥1年者。中位最大減重12.5%（IQR 7.9-17.9），中位達成時間19個月。基線臨床特徵模型僅能解釋<10%變異，主要來自女性性別。女性最高劑量2.4 mg減重最多（16.6%對男性12.4%）；基線特徵無法預測減重幅度。

diabetes.title: An international position statement on practical approaches for inpatient continuous glucose monitoring, insulin pumps and automated insulin delivery systems in adults
diabetes.title_zh: 成人住院期間連續血糖監測、胰島素幫浦與自動胰島素輸注系統實務應用之國際立場聲明
diabetes.abstract: International position statement (co-published in Diabetes Care) addressing the unmet need for practical guidance on CGM, insulin pumps and automated insulin delivery in non-critically ill hospitalized adults. It covers patient selection criteria, CGM-derived glycemic metrics and targets, insulin titration and administration, perioperative care, hypo- and hyperglycemia alarm settings, staff training and workflows, EHR data integration, imaging considerations and discharge planning.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 國際立場聲明（同步刊於Diabetes Care），針對非重症住院成人使用CGM、胰島素幫浦及自動胰島素輸注系統提出實務指引。內容涵蓋病人選擇標準、CGM血糖指標與目標、胰島素調整與給藥、手術周邊照護、低／高血糖警示設定、人員訓練與流程、電子病歷資料整合、影像檢查注意事項及出院規劃。

diabetes.title: 2026 EASD evidence-based clinical practice guideline for assessing and managing diabetes distress among adults with type 1 diabetes or type 2 diabetes
diabetes.title_zh: 2026年EASD第1型與第2型糖尿病成人糖尿病困擾評估與管理實證臨床指引
diabetes.abstract: EASD guideline developed with GRADE methodology and a multidisciplinary panel including lived-experience experts, addressing two clinical questions on identifying and reducing diabetes distress. Eight Good Practice Statements call for routine discussion of emotional well-being, validated tools and ongoing monitoring. Conditional recommendations support psychological interventions, CGM and automated insulin delivery in type 1 diabetes, and psychological, psychoeducational and educational interventions in type 2 diabetes.
diabetes.abstract_zh: EASD採用GRADE方法並納入病友經驗專家，針對糖尿病困擾之辨識與治療兩項臨床問題制訂指引。八項良好實務聲明建議常規討論情緒健康、使用經驗證工具並持續追蹤。條件性建議：第1型糖尿病支持心理介入、CGM與自動胰島素輸注；第2型糖尿病支持心理、心理教育及衛教介入以降低困擾。

ckd.title: Results from the Phase 2 Explore-CKD Trial of lorundrostat, a novel aldosterone synthase inhibitor, in participants with uncontrolled hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and albuminuria
ckd.title_zh: 新型醛固酮合成酶抑制劑 lorundrostat 用於血壓控制不良合併 CKD 及白蛋白尿患者：Explore-CKD 第二期試驗結果
ckd.abstract: In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover phase 2 trial, 59 adults with uncontrolled hypertension, CKD (mean cystatin C-eGFR 43 mL/min/1.73 m2) and albuminuria (geometric mean UACR 517 mg/g) on RAAS blockade plus SGLT2i received lorundrostat 25 mg/day for 4 weeks. Placebo-adjusted automated office systolic BP fell 7.5 mm Hg and UACR fell 25.6%; eGFR dipped modestly (42.9 to 40.1). Three participants discontinued for adverse events including hyperkalemia and AKI.
ckd.abstract_zh: 此隨機雙盲、安慰劑對照交叉設計第二期試驗納入 59 位血壓控制不良、CKD（平均 eGFR 43）且有白蛋白尿（UACR 幾何平均 517 mg/g）、已使用 RAAS 阻斷劑加 SGLT2i 的成人，加用 lorundrostat 25 mg/日 4 週。經安慰劑校正後收縮壓下降 7.5 mmHg、UACR 下降 25.6%，eGFR 輕微下降（42.9→40.1）；3 人因不良事件（含高血鉀、AKI）停藥。

ckd.title: The Role of Angiopoietin-Like Proteins 3 and 4 and Their Target Lipases in CKD: A Drug-Target Mendelian Randomization Study
ckd.title_zh: 血管生成素樣蛋白 ANGPTL3、ANGPTL4 及其標靶脂酶在 CKD 中的角色：藥物標靶孟德爾隨機化研究
ckd.abstract: Drug-target Mendelian randomization across 2,369,738 individuals (186,388 CKD cases) of European, East Asian and African ancestry tested genetically proxied ANGPTL3/ANGPTL4 inhibition and lipase enhancement. Per 1-SD lower triglycerides, ANGPTL3 inhibition (OR 0.76), ANGPTL4 inhibition (OR 0.78) and lipoprotein lipase enhancement (OR 0.86) were associated with lower CKD risk and higher eGFR. Single-cell RNA-seq showed differential kidney expression of these genes, supporting ANGPTL3/4 as CKD therapeutic targets.
ckd.abstract_zh: 藥物標靶孟德爾隨機化研究納入歐洲、東亞及非洲族裔共 2,369,738 人（186,388 位 CKD 病例）。每降低 1 個標準差三酸甘油酯，基因模擬的 ANGPTL3 抑制（OR 0.76）、ANGPTL4 抑制（OR 0.78）及脂蛋白脂酶增強（OR 0.86）皆與較低 CKD 風險及較高 eGFR 相關；單細胞 RNA 定序顯示這些基因在腎臟表現有差異，支持其作為 CKD 治療標靶。

ckd.title: A Perspective on the Role of Nephrologists in the Cardio-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome
ckd.title_zh: 觀點：腎臟科醫師在心腎代謝（CKM）症候群中的角色
ckd.abstract: This perspective argues nephrology must shift from a specialty centered on organ failure, dialysis and transplantation toward prevention, early diagnosis and delaying progression within the newly defined cardio-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome. The authors call for refining the CKM model with greater diagnostic precision for CKD and kidney outcomes, question its linearity given CKD-CVD complexity, and urge redesign of training programs and care models so nephrologists lead in diagnosis, pharmacology, holistic CVD risk management and research.
ckd.abstract_zh: 本觀點文章主張腎臟科應從以器官衰竭、透析與移植為中心，轉向 CKM 症候群架構下的預防、早期診斷與延緩進展。作者呼籲以更精確的 CKD 診斷及腎臟結局來精進 CKM 模型，質疑其線性假設，並建議重新設計訓練與照護模式，使腎臟科醫師在診斷、藥理、整體心血管風險管理與研究中扮演主導角色。

taiwan_news.title: 健保9/1起首度給付罕見膽汁鬱積搔癢新藥 ALGS、PFIC病童受惠
taiwan_news.summary: 健保署自9月1日起新增給付含 maralixibat 成分藥品，用於一歲以上阿拉吉歐症候群（ALGS）與進行性家族性肝內膽汁滯留症（PFIC）病人的膽汁鬱積搔癢，可降低血清膽酸、改善反覆摳抓破皮；另納入PNH口服新藥，本次新措施總挹注藥費25.48億元。

taiwan_news.title: 一次切除15顆大腸腺瘤！醫：大多數大腸癌由腺瘤演變，定期篩檢最有效
taiwan_news.summary: 胃腸肝膽科醫師張靖分享單次大腸鏡切除15顆腺瘤的罕見個案，強調大腸癌多由腺瘤長大癌變而來，發現就該切除。除家族遺傳外，建議少吃加工肉品、多攝取蔬菜纖維、規律運動避免肥胖，並定期做大腸鏡或糞便潛血檢查。

taiwan_news.title: 流感疫情持續上升 疾管署：公費抗病毒藥擴大用藥條件延長至10/31
taiwan_news.summary: 疾管署9月18日表示流感已進入流行期且持續上升，公費流感抗病毒藥劑「有類流感症狀之高傳播族群」（醫事人員、長照機構、幼托與學生、與高風險者同住等7類）適用期限延長至10月31日；符合條件者不需快篩即可由醫師開立，全國約4千家合約院所配置克流感與易剋冒。
taiwan_news.source: 衛生福利部疾病管制署
taiwan_news.topic: 流感公費抗病毒藥延長

taiwan_news.title: 放屁特別臭別只怪吃肉 醫：合併腹瀉、脂肪便、體重下降要就醫
taiwan_news.summary: 胃腸肝膽科醫師楊子緯指出，成人每天放屁10～20次屬正常，臭味多來自腸道菌分解含硫胺基酸（紅肉、蛋、豆類、十字花科蔬菜）。但若持續惡臭並合併腹瀉、油亮黏膩的脂肪便與不明原因體重下降，可能是吸收不良、菌相失衡或腸道感染，應盡速檢查。

taiwan_news.title: 手搖飲稽查：知名連鎖店腸桿菌科超標140倍 食藥署共裁罰105萬
taiwan_news.summary: 食藥署9月17日公布「現場調製飲品及冰品稽查專案」結果，查核387家、抽驗448件，6件不合格；台北一家青山分店檢出腸桿菌科1400 CFU/ml（限量10），另有咖啡因標示不符、食品逾期、未投保產品責任險等違規，合計裁罰105萬元。

nejm.title: Colonoscopy Intervals and Colorectal Cancer Incidence after Adenoma Removal (EPoS II)
nejm.title_zh: 高風險腺瘤切除後 5 年 vs 3 年追蹤大腸鏡：EPoS II 試驗期中分析
nejm.abstract: In this European noninferiority trial, 10,799 patients with high-risk adenomas were randomized to first surveillance colonoscopy at 5 years or 3 years after polyp removal. At the 5.5-year interim analysis, cumulative colorectal cancer incidence was 0.77% with 5-year surveillance versus 0.82% with 3-year surveillance, meeting noninferiority. Cancer stage distribution and colorectal cancer deaths did not differ substantially between groups.
nejm.abstract_zh: 歐洲八國非劣性試驗納入10,799名高風險腺瘤（≥10 mm、高度異生、絨毛狀或3–10顆）病人，隨機分配息肉切除後5年或3年做第一次追蹤大腸鏡。5.5年期中分析顯示，5年組大腸癌累積發生率0.77%、3年組0.82%，達非劣性；分期分布與大腸癌死亡無明顯差異，支持放寬追蹤間隔。

nejm.title: Blinatumomab for Replacing Chemotherapy in Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
nejm.title_zh: Blinatumomab 取代化療用於兒童高風險 B 細胞急性淋巴性白血病
nejm.abstract: In this randomized trial of 709 children with newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell ALL, replacing two consolidation chemotherapy cycles with blinatumomab increased estimated 4-year event-free survival from 70.3% to 83.0% (hazard ratio 0.51). Treatment-related infections fell from 69.4% to 23.9%, and life-threatening adverse events were fewer, although neurotoxic events were more frequent with blinatumomab.
nejm.abstract_zh: 709名新診斷高風險B細胞ALL兒童隨機分組，以兩個週期 blinatumomab 取代傳統化療。中位追蹤2.9年，4年無事件存活率由70.3%提升至83.0%（HR 0.51）；治療相關感染從69.4%降至23.9%，危及生命不良事件也較少，但神經毒性事件較多（12.0% vs 3.2%）。

nejm.title: Tambotatug Pelitecan in Small-Cell Lung Cancer after Platinum-Based Therapy (TAISHAN-302)
nejm.title_zh: B7-H3 抗體藥物複合體 Tam-Peli 用於鉑類治療後小細胞肺癌：第三期試驗
nejm.abstract: In this phase 3 trial, 451 patients with small-cell lung cancer progressing after platinum-based therapy were randomized to tambotatug pelitecan, a B7-H3-targeting antibody-drug conjugate, or topotecan. Median overall survival was 13.3 versus 9.4 months (hazard ratio 0.46), progression-free survival 7.4 versus 2.8 months, and objective response 59.1% versus 9.7%, with fewer grade 3 or higher adverse events.
nejm.abstract_zh: 451名鉑類治療後惡化的小細胞肺癌病人隨機接受 B7-H3 標靶 ADC 藥物 tambotatug pelitecan 或 topotecan。中位整體存活13.3 vs 9.4個月（HR 0.46），無惡化存活7.4 vs 2.8個月，客觀反應率59.1% vs 9.7%，且≥3級不良事件反而較少（55.4% vs 77.9%）。

lancet.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α- or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): phase 3 trial
lancet.title_zh: 口服 mitapivat 用於輸血依賴型地中海型貧血：ENERGIZE-T 第三期試驗
lancet.abstract: ENERGIZE-T randomized 258 adults with transfusion-dependent α- or β-thalassaemia across 19 countries to oral mitapivat 100 mg twice daily or placebo for 48 weeks. Transfusion reduction response occurred in 30% versus 13% (adjusted difference 18 percentage points). Common adverse events included headache, upper respiratory infection, insomnia, diarrhoea and fatigue; no deaths occurred, supporting mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy.
lancet.abstract_zh: ENERGIZE-T 於19國納入258名輸血依賴型α或β地中海型貧血成人，隨機接受口服丙酮酸激酶活化劑 mitapivat 或安慰劑48週。輸血量減少反應率30% vs 13%（差異18個百分點，p=0.0003）；常見副作用為頭痛、上呼吸道感染、失眠、腹瀉，無死亡，為首個口服疾病修飾療法。

lancet.title: Catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation (PVI-SHAM-AF): a randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled trial
lancet.title_zh: 心房顫動導管消融 vs 假手術：PVI-SHAM-AF 雙盲隨機試驗
lancet.abstract: In this double-blind sham-controlled trial, 262 patients with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation were randomized 2:1 to catheter ablation or a sham procedure. At 6 months, AFEQT quality-of-life scores improved substantially in both groups (61.3 to 81.1 versus 59.2 to 74.9), with a nonsignificant between-group difference of 2.6 points. Ablation did not demonstrate superiority over sham for symptom-related quality of life.
lancet.abstract_zh: 德國與波蘭9個中心262名有症狀心房顫動病人，以2:1隨機接受導管消融或假手術，雙盲追蹤6個月。兩組 AFEQT 生活品質分數皆明顯改善（61.3→81.1 vs 59.2→74.9），組間差異僅2.6分（p=0.36），消融未顯示優於假手術，顯示安慰劑效應在症狀改善中扮演重要角色。

jama.title: Liquid Biopsies for Cancer: A Translational Science Review
jama.title_zh: 癌症液態切片（ctDNA）：轉譯科學回顧
jama.abstract: This review summarizes circulating tumor DNA applications: guiding molecularly targeted therapy in lung, colorectal and breast cancer, monitoring treatment response, and detecting minimal residual disease. Post-treatment ctDNA detection strongly predicts recurrence; in colorectal cancer, molecular relapse was detected about 8.7 months earlier than imaging. Optimal testing timing, management of ctDNA-positive imaging-negative patients, and cost-effectiveness remain unresolved.
jama.abstract_zh: 本回顧整理循環腫瘤DNA（ctDNA）在肺癌、大腸癌、乳癌的臨床應用：指引標靶治療選擇、監測治療反應與偵測微量殘留疾病。治療後ctDNA陽性與復發及較差存活強烈相關；大腸癌中分子復發比影像早約8.7個月被發現。最佳檢測時機、影像陰性但ctDNA陽性的處置及成本效益仍待釐清。

jama.title: High-Dose Intravenous Vitamin C and Mortality and Organ Dysfunction in Severe Burn Injury: The VICTORY Randomized Clinical Trial
jama.title_zh: 高劑量靜脈維生素 C 用於嚴重燒傷：VICTORY 隨機試驗提前中止
jama.abstract: In this international phase 3 trial, 238 adults with deep burns covering at least 20% body surface area were randomized to intravenous vitamin C 50 mg/kg every 6 hours for 96 hours or placebo. The composite of 28-day mortality and persistent organ dysfunction occurred in 40.8% versus 29.7%, and 28-day mortality was higher with vitamin C (15.0% vs 7.6%), prompting early termination for futility and possible harm.
jama.abstract_zh: 24個燒傷中心238名體表面積≥20%深度燒傷成人，隨機接受高劑量靜脈維生素C（50 mg/kg每6小時、共96小時）或安慰劑。28天死亡或持續器官功能障礙複合終點40.8% vs 29.7%，28天死亡率15.0% vs 7.6%（RR 1.96），試驗因無效且可能有害而提前中止。

jama.title: Integrated Telehealth Rehabilitation and Quality of Life in Mechanically Ventilated Adults: A Randomized Clinical Trial
jama.title_zh: 整合式遠距復健對呼吸器病人生活品質與死亡率的影響：階梯式叢集隨機試驗
jama.abstract: This stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial in 20 Brazilian public hospitals enrolled 1916 adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure requiring invasive ventilation. A telehealth-based rehabilitation program spanning ICU, ward and 2 months post-discharge modestly improved 90-day EQ-5D-3L utility (0.16 vs 0.12), reduced 90-day mortality (71.8% vs 78.3%) and shortened mechanical ventilation duration (9.9 vs 15.5 days).
jama.abstract_zh: 巴西20家公立醫院階梯式叢集隨機試驗，納入1916名需插管的急性低血氧呼吸衰竭成人。涵蓋ICU、病房到出院後2個月的遠距復健方案，使出院90天EQ-5D-3L效用值略升（0.16 vs 0.12），90天死亡率下降（71.8% vs 78.3%），呼吸器使用天數縮短（9.9 vs 15.5天）。

jama.title: Prognostic Value of Blood-Based P-Tau217 Levels for Progression to Cognitive Impairment
jama.title_zh: 血液 p-tau217 預測認知正常長者進展至認知障礙的絕對風險
jama.abstract: Pooling 2684 cognitively unimpaired older adults from 6 cohorts with median 5.4-year follow-up, each 1-SD increase in baseline plasma p-tau217 raised the hazard of progression to cognitive impairment by 38%, independent of amyloid PET. Participants with high and very high p-tau217 had 24% and 38% absolute 5-year risk, respectively, and faster cognitive decline, supporting p-tau217 for prognostic model development.
jama.abstract_zh: 彙整北美、日本、澳洲6個世代2684名認知正常長者，中位追蹤5.4年。基線血漿p-tau217每升高1個標準差，進展至認知障礙風險增加38%，且獨立於類澱粉PET。p-tau217高與極高者5年絕對風險分別為24%與38%，認知下降也較快，支持作為預後模型與試驗設計依據。

gastro.title: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01 Strain for the Prevention of Multiple-Recurrent Clostridioides difficile Infection
gastro.title_zh: 單一共生菌株 F. prausnitzii EXL01 預防多次復發困難梭菌感染：第一期試驗
gastro.abstract: In a murine CDI model and a multicenter open-label phase 1 trial of six adults with at least three C. difficile episodes, oral Faecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01 given for 8 weeks after vancomycin was safe, and 83.3% remained recurrence-free at week 8, comparable to matched FMT cohorts. Engraftment correlated with restored secondary bile acid and butyrate production, supporting function-targeted precision microbiome therapy.
gastro.abstract_zh: 於小鼠模型與多中心開放性第一期試驗中，6名至少3次困難梭菌感染的成人在 vancomycin 前置後口服 F. prausnitzii EXL01 八週，無治療相關嚴重不良事件，第8週83.3%未復發，與配對FMT世代相當。菌株定殖與次級膽酸及丁酸恢復相關，支持以功能為標的的精準微菌療法。

gastro.title: Gastrointestinal Disorders in Scleroderma
gastro.title_zh: 硬皮症的腸胃道表現：從食道到肛門的全面回顧
gastro.abstract: This review covers gastrointestinal involvement in systemic sclerosis, which affects the esophagus in about 90% of patients and produces dysphagia, reflux, gastroparesis, gastric antral vascular ectasia, pseudo-obstruction, small intestinal bacterial overgrowth, constipation and fecal incontinence. Impaired motility from smooth-muscle atrophy and fibrosis is central; symptoms correlate poorly with pathology, and management largely extrapolates from non-scleroderma evidence.
gastro.abstract_zh: 本回顧整理全身性硬化症的腸胃道侵犯，約90%病人食道受累，表現為吞嚥困難、胃食道逆流、胃輕癱、胃竇血管擴張、假性腸阻塞、小腸細菌過度生長、便秘與糞失禁。平滑肌萎縮與纖維化導致的蠕動障礙是核心機轉；症狀與病理相關性差，治療多引用非硬皮症證據，需高度警覺並個別化處置。

gastro.title: Clonal Lymphocyte Expansions and JAK-STAT Pathway Mutations Define a Pathogenic Continuum Driving Resistance to Gluten-Free Diet in Celiac Disease
gastro.title_zh: 頑固型乳糜瀉的克隆淋巴球擴增與 JAK-STAT 突變：JAK 抑制劑單一治療的隱憂
gastro.abstract: Using single-cell transcriptomic, genomic and TCR profiling of duodenal biopsies and blood from patients with type 1 and type 2 refractory celiac disease, the authors show malignant RCD2 lymphocytes are heterogeneous and that JAK inhibitors can select drug-resistant clones in vitro. In RCD1, clonal T-cell expansions with JAK-STAT-enhancing mutations were identified, suggesting a shared pathogenic continuum and caution against JAK inhibitor monotherapy.
gastro.abstract_zh: 研究以單細胞轉錄體、基因體與TCR分析第一型與第二型頑固型乳糜瀉的十二指腸切片與血液。RCD2惡性淋巴球具高度腫瘤內異質性，體外JAK抑制劑可篩選出抗藥克隆；RCD1亦發現帶有增強JAK-STAT路徑突變的克隆T細胞擴增。兩者可能共享克隆演化機轉，提示JAK抑制劑單一治療的風險。

gastro.title: Pre-Crohn's Disease Stool From Discordant Siblings Promotes the Development of Colitis in Germ-Free Mice
gastro.title_zh: 克隆氏症發病前的糞便菌相即可在無菌鼠誘發更嚴重腸炎
gastro.abstract: Germ-free mice were colonized with stool from 12 sibling pairs in which one sibling later developed Crohn's disease. After T-cell transfer colitis induction, recipients of pre-Crohn's stool showed greater weight loss, fecal lipocalin-2 and histologic damage than recipients of healthy sibling stool. Forty fecal metabolites differed, and sphingolipids correlated with colitis in both humans and mice, demonstrating pre-diagnostic microbiome alterations with inflammatory potential.
gastro.abstract_zh: 研究將12對不一致手足（一人日後罹患克隆氏症）的糞便移植至無菌鼠，再以T細胞轉移誘發腸炎。接受「發病前」糞便的小鼠體重減輕更多、糞便lipocalin-2與組織損傷更嚴重；40種糞便代謝物有差異，鞘脂類在人與鼠皆與腸炎相關，證實診斷前數年腸道菌相已具致炎潛能。

hepato.title: Lactulose with or without TeleTai-Chi for the prevention of falls: A sequential multiple assignment randomized controlled trial (LiveSMART)
hepato.title_zh: Lactulose 合併遠距太極預防肝硬化病人跌倒：LiveSMART 序貫隨機試驗
hepato.abstract: In this 24-week SMART trial of 230 adults with cirrhosis and portal hypertension without prior overt hepatic encephalopathy, lactulose reduced injurious falls (3.5% vs 8.5%) and non-injurious falls (15.0% vs 26.5%) versus non-use, with a win ratio of 2.3. Sequential lactulose followed by TeleTai-Chi was superior to enhanced usual care (win ratio 2.7) on a hierarchical composite of death, falls and encephalopathy.
hepato.abstract_zh: 美國四中心24週序貫多重分配隨機試驗，納入230名有門脈高壓但無明顯肝性腦病變的肝硬化成人。使用lactulose者受傷性跌倒3.5% vs 8.5%、非受傷性跌倒15.0% vs 26.5%（勝率比2.3）；lactulose接續遠距太極相較加強常規照護，在死亡/移植、跌倒與腦病變的階層複合終點上更優（勝率比2.7）。

hepato.title: Shear wave elastography demonstrates similar risk stratification performance to vibration-controlled transient elastography in FIB-4-based two-step algorithms for MASLD
hepato.title_zh: 剪力波彈性成像（SWE）在 MASLD 兩階段風險分層中表現與 FibroScan 相當
hepato.abstract: Among 2817 MASLD patients who underwent same-session VCTE and SWE, AGA- and EASL-based two-step algorithms using SWE stratified liver-related event risk (subdistribution hazard ratios up to 18.9 for high-risk groups). Time-dependent AUCs through 60 months were 0.770 vs 0.775 (AGA) and 0.804 vs 0.805 (EASL) for SWE vs VCTE, with strong correlation (rho 0.713), indicating comparable predictive performance without formal equivalence.
hepato.abstract_zh: 2817名同一次檢查同時接受FibroScan（VCTE）與剪力波彈性成像（SWE）的MASLD病人，依AGA與EASL兩階段流程分層。SWE分層可有效區分肝臟相關事件風險（高風險組sHR達18.9）；60個月時間相依AUC分別為0.770 vs 0.775（AGA）、0.804 vs 0.805（EASL），兩者相關性強（ρ=0.713），預測表現相當。

hepato.title: A First-in-Human study of AHB-137, an unconjugated antisense oligonucleotide, in healthy subjects and patients with chronic hepatitis B
hepato.title_zh: 反義寡核苷酸 AHB-137 首次人體試驗：慢性 B 肝病人 HBsAg 快速下降
hepato.abstract: This phase 1 study evaluated AHB-137, an unconjugated antisense oligonucleotide targeting all HBV mRNAs, in 40 healthy volunteers and 24 virally suppressed HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B patients. Adverse events were mainly mild injection-site reactions and headache, with no serious treatment-related events. Pharmacokinetics were dose-proportional with a 150-220 hour half-life; HBsAg declined 0.7-1.0 log10 IU/mL, and three patients achieved HBsAg loss at least once.
hepato.abstract_zh: 第一期試驗評估針對所有HBV mRNA的非接合反義寡核苷酸AHB-137，納入40名健康受試者與24名病毒抑制中的HBeAg陰性慢性B肝病人。不良事件多為輕度注射部位反應與頭痛，無嚴重治療相關事件；藥動學呈劑量比例、半衰期150–220小時。HBsAg平均下降0.7–1.0 log，3名病人曾達HBsAg消失。

hepato.title: BEACON-HCC: Best evidence and North American consensus on treatment allocation for hepatocellular carcinoma
hepato.title_zh: BEACON-HCC：北美肝細胞癌治療分配共識框架
hepato.abstract: Through a modified Delphi process, 20 North American experts across hepatology, oncology, surgery, radiology and radiation oncology developed BEACON-HCC, a treatment allocation framework incorporating intrahepatic tumor burden, vascular invasion, adverse prognostic markers, external beam radiation, radioembolization and systemic-locoregional combinations. In 29 real-world cases, expert decisions showed 96.6% concordance with BEACON-HCC versus 72.4% with BCLC 2025.
hepato.abstract_zh: 20位北美肝臟科、腫瘤科、外科、放射科與放射腫瘤專家以修正式Delphi法建立BEACON-HCC治療分配框架，納入肝內腫瘤負荷、血管侵犯、不良預後標記，並整合體外放射、放射栓塞與全身合併局部治療。29例真實病例中，專家決策與BEACON-HCC一致率96.6%，與BCLC 2025僅72.4%。

diabetes.title: Calorie-Restricted DASH, Carbohydrate-Restricted, and Low-Purine Diets for Weight Loss and Urate Control in Men With Overweight or Obesity and Hyperuricemia: A Randomized Trial
diabetes.title_zh: 肥胖合併高尿酸男性的三種限熱量飲食比較：DASH 順從性最佳、瘦體重流失最少
diabetes.abstract: In this 12-week randomized trial, 102 men with overweight or obesity and hyperuricemia followed calorie-restricted carbohydrate-restricted, DASH or low-purine balanced diets. Mean weight loss was 8.47 kg (9.3%) with no between-group difference, and serum urate reductions (-0.89, -0.79, -0.50 mg/dL) did not differ significantly. DASH had higher adherence and less lean mass loss; a transient week-1 urate rise coincided with early gout flares.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 102名過重或肥胖合併高尿酸男性隨機接受限熱量（20–25 kcal/kg理想體重）的低碳水、DASH或低普林均衡飲食12週。平均減重8.47 kg（9.3%），三組無差異；血尿酸下降分別為-0.89、-0.79、-0.50 mg/dL亦無顯著差異。DASH順從性較高、軟瘦體重流失較少；第1週尿酸短暫上升並伴隨痛風急性發作高峰。

diabetes.title: The Management of Type 1 Diabetes in Adults: The Updated 2026 Consensus Report by the ADA and EASD
diabetes.title_zh: 2026 ADA/EASD 成人第一型糖尿病管理共識更新
diabetes.abstract: This 2026 ADA/EASD consensus report updates the 2021 guidance on managing type 1 diabetes in adults, emphasizing integration of new technologies such as automated insulin delivery, incorporating new evidence and therapies including interventions to delay stage 3 type 1 diabetes, and broadening scope to screening for long-term complications and management of obesity and cardiovascular risk factors, while retaining psychosocial care and self-management education as core elements.
diabetes.abstract_zh: ADA與EASD發布2026年成人第一型糖尿病管理共識，更新2021版內容，重點強化新科技整合（自動胰島素輸注等），納入延緩第3期第一型糖尿病發病的介入、新療法與新證據，並擴大至長期併發症篩檢、肥胖與心血管風險因子管理；心理社會照護與自我管理衛教仍為核心。

diabetes.title: Maternal and Neonatal Complications in Pregnant Women With Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome: A Nested Prospective Cohort Study
diabetes.title_zh: 多囊性卵巢／PMOS 孕婦的早發妊娠糖尿病與新生兒併發症風險
diabetes.abstract: In a nested cohort of 3645 pregnant women at risk of hyperglycemia within an international gestational diabetes trial, PMOS (PCOS) prevalence was 17.1%. PMOS was independently associated with early gestational diabetes (adjusted OR 1.37), a composite of adverse neonatal outcomes (aOR 1.28), neonatal special care admission (aOR 1.32), and slightly shorter gestation and birth length, with no interaction by BMI or ethnicity.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 在一項國際妊娠糖尿病治療試驗中，3645名高血糖風險孕婦的巢式前瞻世代顯示PMOS（PCOS）盛行率17.1%。PMOS獨立與早發妊娠糖尿病（aOR 1.37）、新生兒不良結果複合終點（aOR 1.28）、新生兒加護／特殊照護入住（aOR 1.32）及較短妊娠週數相關，且與BMI、種族無交互作用，提示需及早辨識與監測。

ckd.title: Initial Changes in eGFR during Treatment with Balcinrenone and Dapagliflozin: An Exploratory Analysis of the MIRO-CKD Trial
ckd.title_zh: 新型非類固醇 MRA balcinrenone 合併 dapagliflozin 的早期 eGFR 下降：MIRO-CKD 探索分析
ckd.abstract: In the phase 2 MIRO-CKD trial, 324 adults with CKD (eGFR 25-60, UACR 100-5000 mg/g) received balcinrenone/dapagliflozin 15/10 mg, 40/10 mg, or dapagliflozin alone. The combination caused a modest, reversible acute eGFR dip at week 4 (-0.6 and -1.7 mL/min/1.73 m2 vs dapagliflozin). Larger acute dips were associated with greater UACR and blood pressure reductions, and adverse event rates were low and unrelated to the dip.
ckd.abstract_zh: MIRO-CKD第二期試驗324名CKD成人（eGFR 25–60、UACR 100–5000 mg/g）隨機接受balcinrenone/dapagliflozin 15/10、40/10 mg或單用dapagliflozin。合併治療於第4週出現輕微且可逆的急性eGFR下降（-0.6與-1.7），停藥4週後恢復；急性下降幅度越大者UACR與收縮壓降幅越大，嚴重不良事件少且與eGFR變化無關。

ckd.title: Glucosuria as a Marker of Adherence to Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors and Clinical Outcomes in Real-World Practice
ckd.title_zh: 尿糖作為 SGLT2 抑制劑服藥順從性的客觀指標與真實世界預後
ckd.abstract: Using Optum real-world data (2014-2023), SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with 18-fold higher odds of glucosuria on urinalysis. Among 45,711 patients prescribed SGLT2 inhibitors, 58% showed glucosuria within 6 months; after weighting, glucosuria was associated with lower all-cause mortality (HR 0.78), heart failure hospitalization (HR 0.87) and end-stage kidney disease (HR 0.73), with no association with fractures as a negative control.
ckd.abstract_zh: 分析Optum真實世界資料（2014–2023），使用SGLT2抑制劑者尿液常規出現尿糖的機率高18倍。45,711名處方SGLT2i的病人中58%於6個月內出現尿糖（代表服藥）；加權後尿糖者全因死亡（HR 0.78）、心衰竭住院（HR 0.87）與末期腎病（HR 0.73）風險較低，骨折陰性對照無差異。

ckd.title: Complement in Kidney Disease: Core Curriculum 2026
ckd.title_zh: 補體與腎臟疾病：AJKD 2026 核心課程
ckd.abstract: This core curriculum reviews the complement cascade as a driver of kidney inflammation and summarizes FDA-approved complement inhibitors for five renal indications: atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome, C3 glomerulopathy, immune-complex membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis, ANCA-associated vasculitis and IgA nephropathy. It covers ongoing trials of new anticomplement agents, complement biomarkers in plasma, urine and tissue, and practical laboratory evaluation for nephrologists.
ckd.abstract_zh: 本核心課程回顧補體級聯作為腎臟發炎驅動因子的角色，整理美國FDA已核准補體抑制劑的五種腎臟適應症：非典型溶血性尿毒症候群、C3腎絲球病變、免疫複合體膜增生性腎絲球腎炎、ANCA血管炎與IgA腎病變，並說明進行中的新藥試驗、血漿／尿液／組織補體生物標記與臨床實驗室評估要點。
